request_scope: paper flattened raw turns; no generated conversation history

equal_budget.generation_cap: R * K_phase * C per root, nonbinding
equal_budget.control: C=1 chain shape, same tree executor
equal_budget.generation_cost: equal physical query rows; measured latency may differ

measurement_status: excludes whole steps overlapping observed capture/setup intervals
measurement_note: No duration outlier filter; raw time preserved. Successful full prewarm still needs a no-new-capture check.

request_population.policy: mean of valid turns/passes within question, then mean across questions
request_population.time_definition: shared batch decode time while request active; not aggregate TPS
